question: Owner 2026-10-28: build a 1m model; step 1 downloads Binance UM 1m klines around every touch and computes features through the minute before the touch (recent volume bursts and speed).
source: data.binance.vision futures/um/daily/klines/{symbol}/1m (public archive; touch day and the day before)
decision_point: close of the last 1m bar before the touch minute; only completed bars before it are read
control: Not directional. Parity: the earlier partial-bar study showed these 1m archives reproduce the Codex 5m bars; touch_not_in_1m counts events whose 1m bars do not reach the level
